preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10000.
The number of digits in N must be between 1 and 18.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789' for c in str(N))
preconditions.description: All characters in N must be digits from 0 to 9.

postconditions.description: The output must be the rank of the number N among all permutations of its digits.
